title: Elevate UI Performance: Master CSS 'font-display' for Optimal Web Font Loading and UX
tweet: Boost your site's UI & UX! Learn how CSS 'font-display' manages web font loading, preventing layout shifts & ensuring a smooth experience. A must-know for every typography expert. #CSStypography #WebFonts #UIDesign #UX
tip: Using 'font-display: swap' is often the best balance for user experience. It prioritizes content display immediately with a fallback font, then 'swaps' in your custom web font once loaded, minimizing perceived page load time and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
